# Synthetic BC2F1 fixture

Generated by `python scripts/make_fixture.py` (seed 20260904); do not edit by hand. Two parents and 40 BC2F1 progeny in families F1 and F2, 500 markers (25 per chromosome, Gm01–Gm20, Wm82.a4.v1 lengths, synthetic map at 2.5 cM/Mb), 475 informative markers. Target locus syn_Gm06_13 (donor allele, state `either`), avoid locus syn_Gm13_10 (must be RP), flank windows 6 cM, count-model background, default weights.

Planted individuals: BC2F1-F1-001 ranks first (target heterozygous with a two-marker donor segment, 28 heterozygous markers elsewhere, no missing calls); BC2F1-F1-002 fails foreground; BC2F1-F2-001 fails the avoid locus; BC2F1-F2-002 is a selfed BC2F2 plant mislabelled as BC2F1 (homozygous-donor calls trigger `possible_self_or_outcross`); BC2F1-F1-003 has 30 % missing calls. expected_results.csv holds statuses, RPP, drag bounds (cM), recombinant flags, composite scores, exclusion reasons and ranks computed by the generator's independent implementation of the formulas in PLAN.md.
